biography:
Visionary and results-driven executive with extensive expertise in data center operations, design, engineering, and large-scale construction management. Proven track record of leading multi-billion-dollar infrastructure projects, optimizing operational efficiency, and driving innovation in hyperscale environments. Adept at building high-performing teams, ensuring world-class safety and quality standards, and delivering strategic solutions to accelerate speed to market. Skilled in global capacity scaling, telecommunications infrastructure, real estate operations and end-to-end project execution for industry leaders like Meta and IBM.
I am a proven leader who thrives most in times of uncertainty. As a foundation I have studied Engineering and Business through 10 years of formal education including: a Bachelor of Science in Architectural Engineering from North Carolina A&T State University, a Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering from NC State University and an MBA in Finance from Wake Forest University. Also I have a wealth of work experiences highlighted by the leadership positions held within Meta and IBM over the last 22 years. In my many capacities I have developed comprehensive energy conservation plans, managed facilities operations, lead major construction activities, directed environmental compliance programs as well as managed critical data center reliability efforts. As a people manager I have been recognized for my constant ability to drive my teams in overachieving company objectives through their personal growth.
